newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian tunnel ceiling crashes, injures three.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian tunnel ceiling crashes, injures three.

text.p: Part of a border tunnel between Slovenia and Austria crashed in on Friday, injuring three people who were driving through it, police said.
Some 350 metres (yards) of ceiling in the 1.5 km (one mile) Ljublj tunnel linking northwestern Slovenia and Austria's southern Carinthia province tumbled down on the Slovenian side.
The three injured were a Slovenian and two Slovakians. Police said their injuries were not serious.
The tunnel was closed but experts left open the possibility that it might be reopened later on Friday if it was judged safe.
